thread: Call page: spacing under the headings
subject: Call page: spacing under the headings
body: Daniel, quick editorial question. The headings on the call page have a lot of air above them on phones. I reduced the top margin by eight pixels. Nothing else moved. Tell me if it looks cramped on your device.

thread: Call page: spacing under the headings
subject: Re: Call page: spacing under the headings
body: Looks fine on my phone, and on the old tablet in the kitchen, which is the real test. Keep it.

thread: Invoice for the Tallinn flights, and a correction
subject: Invoice for the Tallinn flights, and a correction
body:
Hej Daniel,

Invoice 8812 for the flights is attached. I made a mistake in the original quote: the fare for the return leg was shown without the checked-bag fee, and the adjustment is 480 SEK for the two of you. The new total is 7 920 SEK including taxes.

Apologies for the confusion.

Mia

thread: Invoice for the Tallinn flights, and a correction
subject: Re: Invoice for the Tallinn flights, and a correction
body: Daniel, I will pay it but please keep the quote and the corrected invoice together for the auditors. They like to see why the number moved.

subject: February session assignments are out
body:
Dear mentors,

The assignments for February are in your calendars. Each startup got its first preference where there was room and its second where there was not. If one of your sessions looks wrong to you, answer this mail before Friday and I will fix it by hand.

Thank you as always for the time. A few of you asked about a thank-you evening, which we will do after demo day.

Nora

subject: Re: February session assignments are out
body: Nora, I see I have six sessions and two of them are on the Tuesdays I asked for in the evening. Good. The Monday 2 March one collides with a conference in Gothenburg, can that be moved to the Friday before?

subject: Re: February session assignments are out
body: Moved to Friday the 27th, 12:00. The startup said yes within five minutes.

thread: Alumni newsletter: ready for your eyes
subject: Alumni newsletter: ready for your eyes
body:
Karin, the alumni newsletter has your edits. Hiring checklist is six bullets now and the three founders have their own pictures. I added a postscript inviting everyone to the dinner on the 12th.

If you agree, I will schedule it for tomorrow at 08:00.

thread: Alumni newsletter: ready for your eyes
subject: Re: Alumni newsletter: ready for your eyes
body: Send. And thank the three founders personally, they gave you their time for nothing.

subject: Lunch on the 5th: dietary notes
body: Hi Daniel, our canteen asks about dietary requirements for the lunch on the 5th. Anything for you and Karin? Mari from your mentor group also mentioned she may come, she is in Tartu that week.

subject: Re: Lunch on the 5th: dietary notes
body: Karin eats vegetarian, I eat everything. We would be happy to meet Mari. Please add her.

subject: Website: broken link report
body: Hi all, a link checker found two dead links on the blog: an old grant programme page that moved, and the link to a podcast that now sits behind a login. I have replaced the first with the new address and removed the second. If you linked either in an email, please check.

subject: Boarding passes?
body: Hej Mia, do we get the boarding passes through your system or the airline app? The airline app does not recognise the booking code you sent.

subject: Re: Boarding passes?
body: Use the code beginning with K, the one in the PDF footer, not the one on the invoice. I have also sent them as attachments so you can print at the airport.

thread: Hamnkontoret: stage riser and the cloakroom
subject: Hamnkontoret: stage riser and the cloakroom
body:
Hello Daniel,

Two small questions before the event. We have a stage riser, 30 cm high, which is included in the price if you want it. Cloakroom staff are 350 SEK an hour per person, and I would plan for two people for four hours. Reply with yes or no on each.

Lars

thread: Hamnkontoret: stage riser and the cloakroom
subject: Re: Hamnkontoret: stage riser and the cloakroom
body: Riser yes, cloakroom yes with two people. Please add 3 hours either side of the doors opening, we will have teams coming early to test their slides.

subject: Tallinn: three things we learnt
body:
Short report from Tallinn. The Tech Hub runs its founder evening on a rotating theme, which keeps repeat visitors interested. Their application form is a single page and they get few abandoned forms. Their community lead sends a handwritten card to every founder who finishes the programme.

We will try the cards in June. I bought a stack of postcards at the airport.

subject: Funder summary: first pass
body: Karin, first pass of the funder summary is in the folder. Two pages, one table on cost per startup. Cohort cost is 2 percent under plan, with the demo day still to come. I added a sentence about the invoices in EUR we pay to our partners in the Baltics, since the funders have asked before.

subject: Re: Funder summary: first pass
body: Good. Keep the EUR sentence short and do not mention numbers, they change every month.

subject: Photos from Tallinn?
body: Tomas, I read that Karin and Daniel were in Tallinn. If you want a photographer for the autumn event there, I am happy to travel. My day rate is the same, plus travel.

subject: Re: Photos from Tallinn?
body: Not yet decided, but I will keep you in mind. Please send me a price for a full day including editing.

thread: Demo day: my two score sheets
subject: Demo day: my two score sheets
body:
Daniel, attached are the two sheets for demo day. One is for the pitch, six lines. One is for substance, five lines. I give a 1 to 5 on each line and then average. My experience is that panels like having numbers on the table so the discussion can start with the spread, not with the loudest voice.

Astrid

thread: Demo day: my two score sheets
subject: Re: Demo day: my two score sheets
body: Thank you. Karin says yes to two sheets. We will print them on different colours of paper so they cannot get mixed up.

subject: Re: February session assignments are out
body: Nora, I hit reply-all by mistake and this has gone to the whole mentor list. What I wanted to tell you is that the session on the 17th must be moved by one hour, I am stuck in a workshop. Can we shift it to 15:00?

subject: Re: February session assignments are out
body: Joonas, fine, moved to 15:00. For the next time, please use my address and not the list. The whole mentor group got your note.

subject: Invoice 2025-1243: January bookkeeping
body:
Hej Anders,

January bookkeeping is invoiced at 4 250 SEK plus VAT. Receipts from the travel card were received after the deadline we set for the January close, so I booked them in the February ledger. That is why the two months differ a little in my report. No action needed from you.

Ulrika

thread: Newsletter: February draft needs a topic
subject: Newsletter: February draft needs a topic
body: Karin, February's newsletter does not have a lead story. Options: the winter demo day, the grant writing session in March, or a profile of a mentor. I would lean towards demo day because tickets are limited and we want a good turnout.

thread: Newsletter: February draft needs a topic
subject: Re: Newsletter: February draft needs a topic
body: Demo day on top, mentor profile below. Make it Liis, she has written something about brand that I want everyone to read.

thread: Funder summary: second pass and a question
subject: Funder summary: second pass and a question
body: Karin, I merged your comments into the funder summary. One question: should the table show cost per startup including the founders' travel to the demo day, or only our own? I would show only our own, the other number is hard to track.

subject: Re: round 2 call page
body:
Karin, I have the editing window at noon today. Is there anything you want on the call page or in a mail to the list before then? If not, it is only the typo in the contact box.

Sofia

subject: Alumni dinner on Thursday: numbers
body: Karin, 34 people signed up for the alumni dinner on Thursday, and we have seats for 40. The food order is placed. Two guests need step-free access, so I booked the table by the door for them.

subject: Re: round 2 call page
body:
Sofia, yes, one thing. The +3 points for founders who took part in an earlier Fieldnote programme no longer apply to applications received after 2026-02-10T12:00:00+01:00. Applications received up to and including that moment keep them.

Please send the note to the list at 12:00 sharp, and not a minute before.

Karin

subject: Poster proofs: final
body: Hi Sofia, the posters for the winter demo day are proofed and fine. I changed nothing except nudging the logo 2 mm to the left so it clears the trim. Ready on Friday.

subject: Re: round 2 call page
body:
Understood, the note is scheduled for 12:00:00 exactly and I have left the wording as you wrote it. Shall I put the same words on the page when the mail goes out?

Sofia

thread: Round 2: interview rooms at the end of March
subject: Round 2: interview rooms at the end of March
body:
Hello Lars,

We would like to reserve two meeting rooms at Hamnkontoret for the round 2 interview days in the last week of March, from morning to late afternoon on both days. Please tell us what you charge and whether lunch can be arranged in the building. The rooms must be quiet and close to a waiting area.

Thank you,
Daniel Osei

subject: Round 2: an update
body:
Hello,

A short note on the round 2 call.

The +3 points for founders who took part in an earlier Fieldnote programme no longer apply to applications received after 2026-02-10T12:00:00+01:00. Applications received up to and including that moment keep them.

Questions to programme@fieldnote.example.

The Fieldnote programme team

subject: Re: round 2 call page
body:
Yes, same words on the page. It landed in my own inbox at 12:00, thank you.

Karin

subject: AV: rider and the truck
body: Hi Daniel, we received the stage plan. The truck can park behind the hall at 11:30 on the 26th. We need one power outlet by the stage that is not on the same fuse as the kitchen. Please ask Lars to check the fuse list.

subject: Invoice adjustment: Postwise
body:
Hej Anders, the Postwise bill for February came in at the higher price after all, although you switched plans. The vendor says the old plan stays in force until the end of the billing month. I have booked the difference as an adjustment and expect a credit note in March, which I will match against the next invoice.

Ulrika

subject: Mentor thank-you evening: date options
body: Karin, three dates for the mentor thank-you evening: 2 April, 9 April or 16 April. Most mentors are free on the second. The restaurant on Katarina Bangata would take 20 people for a set menu.

subject: Re: Mentor thank-you evening: date options
body: 2 April is fine. Book it and tell Anders the cost so we can set the line aside. Keep it under 20 000 SEK.

thread: Round 2: reporting guidance for companies in Finland and Estonia
subject: Round 2: reporting guidance for companies in Finland and Estonia
body:
Hello,

If your company is registered in Finland or Estonia, please read this note before you fill in the financial parts of your application. Read the help text next to each financial question carefully, and keep your accountant's summary within reach in case we ask a follow-up. Where you are unsure how a question applies to your company, write one line saying so in the free-text box rather than guessing.

If you have questions about a specific figure, write to programme@fieldnote.example and mention the section you are in.

The Fieldnote programme team

thread: Round 2: reporting guidance for companies in Finland and Estonia
subject: Re: Round 2: reporting guidance for companies in Finland and Estonia
body: Karin, for your records: the guidance went to the list at 09:15. The FAQ page does not yet mention it. I would add a link, but only if you want that.

thread: Round 2: reporting guidance for companies in Finland and Estonia
subject: Re: Round 2: reporting guidance for companies in Finland and Estonia
body: Link from the FAQ is a good idea. Use the same heading as in the mail.

subject: Catering: revised numbers
body:
Hej Daniel, you asked for a headcount adjustment. I have changed the order from 110 to 96 portions, a drop of fourteen, and the new total is 27 360 SEK excluding VAT. The saving comes mostly from the fish-free menu you chose.

Elin

subject: Re: Catering: revised numbers
body: Thank you. Please keep a reserve of ten extra portions, we expect walk-ins. If the reserve is not used we will not mind paying for it.

subject: Customer interview lab: feedback
body: Nora, quick thoughts after the lab. People loved the role play but wanted fewer slides. The two-minute interview drill was the best moment. I would drop the opening talk next time and start with the drill.

subject: Alumni dinner tonight
body: Hi everyone, reminder that the alumni dinner is tonight at 18:30. The venue is our office, and anyone who can stay after clearing up is welcome to a plate. Please put your desks back so we have space to move the long tables.

subject: Summary received
body: Dear Karin, thank you for the summary. The group will read it before the 19th. We have one comment already: the funder from the region of Uppsala would like to know how many mentors come from outside Stockholm.

subject: Mentors outside Stockholm: how many?
body: Nora, funder question, how many of our mentors live outside Stockholm county? A rough count by tomorrow lunch would do.

subject: Re: Mentors outside Stockholm: how many?
body: Three of eight, Mari in Tartu, Joonas in Helsinki, Oskar in Uppsala. I will write one line about each.

subject: Call page: apostrophes
body: Daniel, a pair of straight quotes on the call page became curly after my edit and in one place the apostrophe went the wrong way. I fixed the typography by hand. No wording changed.

subject: Re: Call page: apostrophes
body: Thanks. I had noticed the apostrophe in "programme's" looked odd on my phone.

thread: I have to withdraw from the panel
subject: I have to withdraw from the panel
body:
Dear Karin,

I am very sorry, but I have to withdraw from the 5 March panel at Nordic Startup Days. My employer has asked me to be at a customer site that week. I know it is late. If it helps, I can suggest a colleague who has the same background.

Ida

thread: I have to withdraw from the panel
subject: Re: I have to withdraw from the panel
body: Ida, thank you for telling me early enough. Of course, work comes first. Yes please, send me your colleague's name and a line about her. We will be glad to hear from her.

thread: Panel update: one speaker has withdrawn
subject: Panel update: one speaker has withdrawn
body:
Dear programme committee,

Ida Sjöberg has withdrawn from the panel on 5 March and proposes a colleague in her place. I will forward the details as soon as I have them. Could you let us know the last date on which a replacement can be added to the printed programme?

Karin

thread: Panel update: one speaker has withdrawn
subject: Re: Panel update: one speaker has withdrawn
body: Dear Karin, the printed programme goes to the printer on 20 February. A replacement named before that date will appear in print. After that we update the online version only.

subject: EUR account top-up
body: Karin, a small treasury item. The EUR account that pays our Baltic partners is low. I will move 20 000 SEK worth over on Monday. It affects nothing but my reconciliation.

thread: Round 2: FAQ copy edits, can you read?
subject: Round 2: FAQ copy edits, can you read?
body: Karin, I tightened the answers in the applicant FAQ. Mostly shorter sentences, and I took out a repeated answer about the cost. Nothing about the content has changed. Please skim before I publish.

thread: Round 2: FAQ copy edits, can you read?
subject: Re: Round 2: FAQ copy edits, can you read?
body: I read all of it. One thing: the answer about confirmation emails says "straight away" and sometimes it takes a minute or two. Say "within a few minutes". Otherwise approved.

thread: Round 2: a reminder to start early
subject: Round 2: a reminder to start early
body:
Hello,

Several of you have told us you are starting your application in the last week. We would suggest starting earlier, saving your answers as you go, and writing to us if the form does anything you do not expect. The closing time is on the call page.

The Fieldnote programme team

thread: Round 2: interview rooms at the end of March
subject: Re: Round 2: interview rooms at the end of March
body: Hello Daniel, the rooms you asked about are free. Two rooms on the first floor, each seating up to twelve, with a waiting area between them. Price is 4 200 SEK per room and day, lunch from our café at 165 SEK per person. I can hold both for fourteen days.

thread: Round 2: interview rooms at the end of March
subject: Re: Round 2: interview rooms at the end of March
body: Hold them, please. I need to check with the panel before we sign, and Karin is away until Thursday.

thread: A startup asks me for a favour
subject: A startup asks me for a favour
body: Nora, a founder asked if I could review their API design outside the session time. I said yes if it takes under an hour. Is there a rule about extra time?

thread: A startup asks me for a favour
subject: Re: A startup asks me for a favour
body: No rule, it is your time. The only thing we ask is that you tell the coordinator if it grows into something regular, so we can book it properly.

subject: Session on the 17th: moved again?
body: Nora, the session at 15:00 today is fine, thanks again. I am bringing a printed copy of the customer interview guide to hand out.

thread: Demo day: do mentors sit with their startups?
subject: Demo day: do mentors sit with their startups?
body: Daniel, on the day, do mentors sit with their startups or in the hall? I would prefer to sit with the team for support, but I know some mentors like the panel seats better.

thread: Demo day: do mentors sit with their startups?
subject: Re: Demo day: do mentors sit with their startups?
body: Sit wherever your startup wants you. We keep the first two rows free for panel and funders, otherwise it is open. I will tell the other mentors the same.

subject: Credit note from Postwise
body: Hej Anders, the Postwise credit note arrived this morning. It covers the difference of the adjustment I mentioned earlier. I booked it against the March invoice, so your net payment next month will be lower.

subject: Delivery: posters and tote bags
body: Hi Sofia, the posters are ready, and the tote bags too. The bags weigh more than we planned because of the thicker cotton, so the carrier adds a fee of 180 SEK for the extra weight. I can put it as a line on the invoice or absorb half of it, up to you.

subject: Re: Delivery: posters and tote bags
body: Split it, we will take half. It is the thicker cotton we asked for, so the bill is fair.

thread: Alumni dinner: thank you and photos
subject: Alumni dinner: thank you and photos
body:
Hello everyone,

Thank you for coming on Thursday. The conversation about hiring ran past ten, and I think we found a few new co-founder matches. Photos are in the shared album. The next alumni evening is planned for the autumn.

Tomas

thread: Alumni dinner: thank you and photos
subject: Re: Alumni dinner: thank you and photos
body: Nice evening. Can you add the table list to the album, so we can find the people we sat with?

subject: Call page: hero photo caption
body: Karin, the caption under the lunch table photo says "Lunch at the office" and someone wrote to ask if it was a real lunch or a stock image. It is real. I added the sentence "Taken on a Tuesday in December." Nothing else changed.

subject: Re: Call page: hero photo caption
body: Love it. Keep the Tuesday.

thread: Travel to the Helsinki day: the fare changed
subject: Travel to the Helsinki day: the fare changed
body: Hej Karin, I have to tell you the morning fare to Helsinki went up by 340 SEK. It is an adjustment on the airline's side and not mine. If you want the fare of last week, only the later flight at 11:15 has it. Tell me what you prefer.

thread: Travel to the Helsinki day: the fare changed
subject: Re: Travel to the Helsinki day: the fare changed
body: Keep the morning flight. We would rather lose the money than the morning.

subject: Funder meeting today
body: Anders, I am leaving for the funder meeting at 09:30. The cost table is on page two, the question about EUR payments may come up. If someone asks for detail, say that the numbers are in the board pack and I will send them.

subject: Funder meeting: it went well
body: The funder group liked the cost table and the plan for demo day. They asked for one more thing: a short note on what we have learnt from the first round before we publish the selection. I will write it after the interviews.

thread: Delivery slot for the AV truck
subject: Delivery slot for the AV truck
body: Hi Daniel, we can only bring the truck to the harbour entrance between 11:00 and 11:45. After that a market closes the road. Is that workable for the venue?

thread: Delivery slot for the AV truck
subject: Re: Delivery slot for the AV truck
body: Yes, that works. I told Lars to expect you at 11:00.

thread: Call page: a typo in the Swedish name
subject: Call page: a typo in the Swedish name
body: Hi all, someone pointed out that Slussen was spelled "Sluzzen" once on the call page. I corrected the word. Please tell me if you see another. I read the page out loud twice and I could not find more.

thread: Call page: a typo in the Swedish name
subject: Re: Call page: a typo in the Swedish name
body: It is better now. I found a double space after a full stop in the third paragraph, I will tell you which.

subject: My colleague for the panel
body: Dear Karin, my colleague is Lena Wass, head of partnerships at the same company. She is delighted to take my place. Her email is in the copy of this message. Many thanks for being so understanding.

thread: Replacement speaker for the 5 March panel
subject: Replacement speaker for the 5 March panel
body: Dear programme committee, the replacement for Ida Sjöberg is Lena Wass. Her bio is attached. Could you confirm that she is in the printed programme? The deadline was yesterday, so I hope we were in time.

thread: Replacement speaker for the 5 March panel
subject: Re: Replacement speaker for the 5 March panel
body: Dear Karin, your message was received after the deadline for the printed programme by two hours, which was a pity, but our printer is flexible this once. Lena Wass is in. Please do not make this a habit.

subject: Hamnkontoret invoice: deposit
body: Daniel, Hamnkontoret is asking for a deposit of 3 000 SEK for the hall. They wrote it in the small print of the confirmation. I will pay it today.

subject: Panel briefing: when and where
body: Hi Astrid, the briefing for the demo day panel is on Tuesday 24 February at 16:00 in our office. We will go through the running order, the two score sheets and who sits where. It lasts 45 minutes.

subject: Re: Panel briefing: when and where
body: I will be there. I will bring a few extra copies of the sheets, the printer at home eats paper.

thread: Conflict form for the demo day
subject: Conflict form for the demo day
body: Daniel, can I have the conflict-of-interest form? I would like to sign it before the briefing so we do not delay.

thread: Conflict form for the demo day
subject: Re: Conflict form for the demo day
body: Attached. Fill in the one team name and sign. You do not need to bring anything else.

thread: Round 2: schedule logistics for the interview stage
subject: Round 2: schedule logistics for the interview stage
body:
Hello,

For those of you who will later be invited to interview: interviews take place at an external venue near Slussen over two days in the last week of March. Each interview is a conversation with a small panel, and we will send directions, a map and the names of the panel members with the invitation. If you need step-free access or a quiet room, tell us in your reply to the invitation.

This note does not tell you whether you will be invited, and nothing in it changes anything in the call.

The Fieldnote programme team

thread: Round 2: schedule logistics for the interview stage
subject: Re: Round 2: schedule logistics for the interview stage
body: Daniel, sent at 14:15 as agreed. Three people have already replied asking if they can pick a time. I answered "not yet, we will write".

thread: Brand office hours: a template for founders
subject: Brand office hours: a template for founders
body: Nora, I made a one-page positioning template that founders can fill in before they see me. Could you put it in the mentor guide folder and mention it in the next newsletter?

thread: Brand office hours: a template for founders
subject: Re: Brand office hours: a template for founders
body: Yes. Send me a PDF and a plain text version. I will ask Sofia about the newsletter.

subject: Allergens list for demo day
body: Hej Daniel, the final allergens list is attached. Everything with nuts is marked on a separate table with cards, and we have gluten free bread. I will bring the labelled trays at 14:30.

subject: Demo day photography schedule
body: Tomas, my plan for demo day: I arrive at 15:00, take pictures of the room before guests, then the teams during the pitches, then the networking. Please give me a person who can introduce me to the stage manager.

subject: Briefing notes for the panel
body: Pontus, notes for tomorrow's briefing: we will not rank the teams, we will give each a short written response. The panel's job is to ask questions and to help the founders see what they cannot see. We will not announce a winner.

subject: Demo day tomorrow: everyone ready?
body: Please read the run sheet again tonight. Tomas has the guest list, Daniel has the keys to the hall at 12:00, Sofia handles the livestream, Nora meets the mentors at the door at 16:00. If something breaks, call me before you try to fix it yourself.

subject: Call page: link underline
body: Karin, links on the call page lost their underline in the last style update, which hurts accessibility. I brought it back. This is a style fix only.

subject: Re: Call page: link underline
body: Good catch, accessibility is not optional. Thank you.

subject: Final adjustment: three more guests
body: Hej Daniel, a last adjustment: please add three portions for the stage crew. I will bill them at the same price per person as the rest. No change to delivery time.

thread: Demo day: first message of the day
subject: Demo day: first message of the day
body: Morning. I am at the hall. Lars has opened it early. The AV truck is expected at 11:00, caterers at 14:30. Coffee for the volunteers is in the kitchen at the back.

subject: Demo day: thank you
body: That was a good evening. Hundred and four guests by Daniel's count, no fire alarms, and the livestream held up. Please enjoy a lie-in tomorrow. I will send the summary on Monday.

thread: Demo day: feedback form results so far
subject: Demo day: feedback form results so far
body: Karin, 41 guests filled in the feedback form overnight. Most liked the short pitches and the standing format. A few said the hall was too warm. The best comment: "Finally a demo day where I could hear the questions."

subject: Thank you for demo day
body: Dear mentors, thank you for sitting with your startups and for the patience with the microphone. Feedback forms for the mentors are in your inbox. Please fill them in during the weekend, it takes five minutes.

subject: Demo day invoices
body: Daniel, venue, AV and catering invoices are in. I compared them with the quotes. All within 3 percent. I will pay the three on Friday unless something is wrong.

thread: Round 2: closing in a few days
subject: Round 2: closing in a few days
body:
Hello,

A final reminder that the application window is closing soon. Check the call page for the exact time. We would like to hear from you and we would rather you finished calmly than in a rush.

The Fieldnote programme team
